Rodada de sábado Ciclópolis

Ciclópolis Saturday ride

Mexico City, Mexico · Coyoacán · Mixed

Rodada de sábado Ciclópolis is a mixed group ride in Mexico City, Mexico. It rolls every Saturday at 7:10 am local time from Ciclópolis Coyoacán.

For visitors

Sign up on the events page. Helmet, gloves, repair kit, water and a rear light are required. The Oct 10 ride is open to road, MTB, gravel, BMX and city bikes.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: level is posted per ride. The Ciudad Universitaria rides (30 km, flat, by the Insurgentes bike lane) are marked beginner to intermediate; the Ajusco and gravel rides are intermediate to advanced..
Check
Look at @ciclopolismx the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Rodada de sábado Ciclópolis group ride

The shop's Saturday morning ride leaves Ciclópolis Coyoacán at 7:10 am and changes route every week. Some weeks are 30 km on the flat to Ciudad Universitaria with a road-safety talk, some are the 70 km Ajusco climb, and one in October is a gravel ride with Gravel Mafia. Distance, climbing and level are posted for each date.
